statement: Refinement of CL450 over C, or over a perfect field with the reduced neutral abelian subvariety N=(kerλ)^0_red: for symmetric λ:A→A∨, quotient by N removes the abelian radical and gives an integral symmetric map with finite kernel. Descent through a further finite quotient exists in the rational isogeny category, with denominators. A finite connected nonreduced kernel in characteristicp must not be conflated with this abelian radical.
